parameters.query:
-- Conta o status de processamento dos centros de custo
-- Opcional: escopo apenas para centros modificados nos últimos N meses (months_back)
WITH params AS (
  SELECT {{ $json.months_back_sql }}::int AS months_back
), scoped AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM auxiliary.status_processamento_cc s
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE (
    p.months_back IS NULL
    OR COALESCE(s.data_modificacao, s.data_cadastro) >= NOW() - (p.months_back || ' months')::interval
  )
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) as total_lines,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status_entradas = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as number_of_entries,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status_saidas = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as number_of_outputs
FROM scoped;

parameters.content:
## Arquitetura do Fluxo

Resume o estado global do processamento de CC.

Retorna:
- running
- total_lines
- number_of_entries
- number_of_outputs

## Agregacao no Banco

Consulta status_processamento_cc e calcula totais:
- linhas
- status_entradas
- status_saidas

## Regra de Running

running = false somente quando:
- entries == total_lines
- e outputs == total_lines

Qualquer pendencia => running = true.
